text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- A trading company of the Ostritch Producers Association of Zimbabwe, Copro, has suspended exporting live birds to the European Union and the Far East because of a slump in demand since those countries now have enough breeding stock of their own.
- The Zimbabwe government has bought three million hectares of land for resettlement since independence from Britian in 1980 at a total cost of Z$140 million.
- The leader of a 45-member Ukranian delegation in Zimbabwe to strengthen economic ties between the two countries on Monday met with Zimbabwean president Robert Mugabe.
